narrative_zh: 天鸽在香港西南约 60 公里掠过并于珠海登陆，风暴潮恰与天文大潮高潮叠加：鲗鱼涌 3.57 米、大埔滘 4.09 米、尖鼻咀 4.56 米（海图基准面）。鲤鱼门三家村、大澳水深及腰，杏花邨海滨受浪。
narrative_en: Hato passed ~60 km southwest of Hong Kong and made landfall at Zhuhai; the surge coincided with a spring high tide: Quarry Bay 3.57 m CD, Tai Po Kau 4.09 m, Tsim Bei Tsui 4.56 m. Waist-deep water in Lei Yue Mun and Tai O.

rain.provenance: HKO daily total 67.1 mm; hourly shape reconstructed

validation.basis: 天文台/新闻：海水及膝至及腰；2024 年报道居民忆述「超过 1 米」
validation.src: HKO/press: knee-to-waist deep sea water; residents of Ma Wan / Ma Pui villages recalled flooding over 1 m (press 2024)

validation.basis: 新闻：数十年最严重；离岛区议会文件：水位超过 3.7 m CD、低洼单层民居被浸过屋顶
validation.src: press: worst flooding in decades; Islands DC paper: sea level exceeded 3.7 m CD, single-storey houses in the low-lying part flooded over the roof

validation.basis: HK01 2025 回顾：2017 年天鸽杏花邨地下停车场「几乎被水注满」、数十辆车报废 → 约 2 m
validation.en: Heng Fa Chuen basement car park
validation.src: HK01 2025-09 retrospective: in Hato (2017) a Heng Fa Chuen basement car park was almost filled with water, dozens of cars written off -> ~2 m
validation.note_zh: 越浪主导（对 Hs 敏感）；海滨步道当时约 0.4 m（新闻）
validation.note_en: Wave-overtopping dominated (sensitive to Hs); the promenade itself was about 0.4 m (press)

validation.note_zh: 与山竹同一取样点（西岸单车径阶地 3.5 mPD，模拟值 = 河道峰值水位 − 3.5）
validation.note_en: Same sample point as Mangkhut (west-bank cycle-track berm 3.5 mPD; sim = peak river level minus 3.5)

validation.note_zh: 位于大埔场景东缘之外

sources: IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility (Quarry Bay)
